blocks.tamil_translation: ?” They said, “Very good brothers. They laid out soft beds for us, gave us excellent food to eat, and morning and evening they taught us the Book of our Lord and the Sunnahs of our Prophet ﷺ.” This conduct of the people of Madinah made Rasulullah ﷺ very happy. The Prophet ﷺ was greatly pleased. Then Rasulullah ﷺ turned his attention to each one of us and enquired. We told him what we had learnt and what had been taught to us. Some of us had been taught At-Tahiyyat, some Surah Al-Fatihah, some one surah, some two surahs, and some others many Sunnahs.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ أَحْسَنَ مَا دَخَلَ الرَّجُلُ عَلي أَهْلِهِ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الطروق، رقم:٢٧٧٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “The best time for one returning from a journey to go to his family is the early part of the night,” Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text: (This is only if he has informed his family beforehand about his arrival, or if he had travelled to a nearby town.)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: نَهَي رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَطَالَ الرَّجُلُ الْغَيْبَةَ، أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهَ طُرُوقاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب كراهة الطروق...، رقم: ٤٩٦٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person has been away from his family in another town for a long time, he should not return to his home at night (without prior notice)
